coverage.note: trial 5: died with both a seal and a merge in flight

findings.statement: the next engine opens after a crash at any point, seals and merges in flight included
findings.detail: 120/120 directories opened; 0 were refused, 0 children failed before crashing. 84 crashes had a seal in flight, 67 a merge, 66 landed with partitions.

findings.statement: under Sync::Always every acknowledged commit survives the crash
findings.detail: 60/60 crashes reopened at or past the last acknowledged batch; 0 lost acked work (worst 0 batches), 0 would not open.

findings.statement: what survives is an exact prefix of the commit order, and count and scan agree with it
findings.detail: 0 recovered states matched no prefix of the commit order; count disagreed with read_all in 0 trials and scan in 0.

findings.statement: recovery invents nothing: every value read back is one the child wrote, byte for byte
findings.detail: 0 values across 120 crashes were not what the stream wrote

findings.statement: under Sync::EveryN(8) a crash loses at most seven acknowledged commits, from the tail
findings.detail: 60/60 crashes reopened within seven batches of the last acknowledged one; the most lost was 6 batches; 0 lost more, 0 matched no prefix, 0 would not open.
